pricing_knowledge.note: High-value projects + a 1200+ client base. AI lead qualification + scoping + past-client re-engagement are high-leverage for a dev shop.

business_profile.competitive_position: Fara competes with other BD dev shops. An AI intake agent that qualifies and scopes projects faster — plus re-engages 1200+ past clients — gives a concrete edge.
business_profile.opportunity_size: High-value projects mean each lost lead is costly, and the 1200+ client base is a dormant repeat-revenue asset. An AI agent recovers lost leads and reactivates past clients.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI lead-qualification agent.
2. Automated project scoping.
3. Proposal routing + follow-up.
4. Past-client re-engagement for upsells.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A prospect submits a web project enquiry at night. The AI scopes the project, qualifies budget, and books a discovery call with a prep brief. Separately, the agent re-engages a past client whose site is due for an upgrade — Fara wins new + repeat work.
